budget_items.topic: Accounts payable, payroll and payroll deductions warrants signed
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed three warrants: accounts payable, payroll, and payroll deductions.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $320,065.21; a payroll warrant in the amount of $837,110.10 and a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $257,799.99.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A FY19 state earmark of not less than $25,000 for the Eagle House lets the town seek reimbursement of up to $25,000 for FY19 expenditures, which will positively affect free cash certified in the fall.
budget_items.quote: not less than $25,000 shall be expended on the lunenburg eagle house senior community center

budget_items.topic: Energy costs for the coming year
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected energy cost is reported as approximately $300 more than the current year, based on current electricity and natural gas usage; the minutes' opening context is missing.
budget_items.quote: approximately $300 more than the current year.

budget_items.topic: 925 Massachusetts Avenue former gas station clean-up
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town has pursued clean-up of the old gas station without taking on clean-up costs, working with Brownfield funds and MassDevelopment; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: without the liability of clean-up costs of this old gas station

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Nexamp community solar offers residents discounted electricity; town, sewer and school accounts are being enrolled, with discounts expected January to March 2020. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: that offers residents discounted electricity from community solar projects

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Consultant Sheri Bean reportedly did not think there was enough in the budget to attend another public audit; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: she didn't think there was enough in the budget for her to attend another public audit

budget_items.topic: MassDEP Education and Enforcement Coordinator Grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board of Health decided not to rush waste hauler regulation changes given the grant due date of June 12th; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the due date of june 12th for the massdep education and enforcement coordinator grant

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Under the draft policy, if the applicant has not cleaned up within 48 hours the Town arranges cleanup and charges the applicant; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: cleanup will be arranged by the town and charged to the applicant.
